title: UAV altitude trade — 2000 m reference altitude
notes: Runner's reference altitude (2 km). NOT re-centered: the 16 ms frame is the microbolometer's thermal time constant (NETD is quoted at it) and cannot move, while the photon-model signal (~5.5e9 e-) is 55x the schema's max full well — so the well/ADC saturation warning is a photon-FPA check misapplied to a bolometer, not a re-centerable operating point. See Gap 101; the scenario's real metric is the delta-T-vs-NETD detection threshold, which is unaffected (CU-170).
